definitions.short: the Nethinim , or Temple-servants (as given to that duty)
definitions.full: H5411. nethinim נְתִינִים noun masculine plural Nethinim (properly those given to the service of the sanctuary, as Levites are called נְתוּנִים Num 3:9 ; 8:16 , 19 ); — only 1Chr 9:2 (where distinguished from priests and Levites) + 16 t. Ezra Nehemiah (often distinguished from priests, Levites and porters; Ezra 8:17 Kt has הנתונים , Qr הַנְּתִינִים ), namely: 2:43 , 58 , 70 = Neh 7:46 ; 7:60 ; 7:72 (so Baer, Ginsb; van d. H. 7:73 ), Ezra 7:7 ; 8:17 , 20 (appointment ascribed to David, compare 1Chr 9:2 ), 9:20 ; Neh 10:29 ; 11:3 ; living on the Ophel 3:26 ; 11:21 ; with their own overseers 11:21 , having a house known (in part) by their name 3:31 . — On ׳נ see further Bau Priesterthum 100, 142 f .
definitions.rootNote: or נָתוּן (Ezra 8:17), (the proper form as passive participle), from 5414 ; one given , i.e. (in the plural only)
